messages:
Rina: Quick idea: run an AMA + Live Tuning Lab — 45m talk, 30m breakout labs, 15m open AMA. Title: 'Tune LLMs for real traffic: latency, cost, and quality tradeoffs.'
Omar: Nice. audience = infra/product engs + small SRE teams. want to surface concrete numbers and playbooks.
Priya: We should split lab tracks by persona: 1) Low-latency chat 2) High-throughput embeddings 3) Accurate reranker. each track gets a tiny starter repo.
Theo: +1. I'll draft three micro-workflows and short prompts for each track. Keep labs 20m each with guided checkpoints.
Rina: Registration form must capture: team size, primary infra (cloud/on-prem), and interest track. That drives followup emails.
Omar: For lead routing, map track -> AE queues: chat -> AE-chat, embeddings -> AE-search, private -> AE-enterprise. Also add a 'pilot interest' flag.
Priya: Launch cadence: teaser week before, reminder day-of, publish repos + quickstart within 24-48h, recording + slide deck within 5 days.
Rina: We should A/B test two landing copy variants: A) product-first (metrics-focused) B) story-first (customer narrative). We'll split 30/70.
Theo: I'll own the A/B test in the landing page. Need two short headlines and one-paragraph abstracts.
ops-bot: Note: rehearsal env provisioning window opens 2025-02-02T14:00Z. Use /book-rehearsal to claim slot.
Omar: Speakers: Rina (platform overview), Theo (lab lead), Priya (case studies + customer metric highlight). Need bios + headshots by EOD Friday.
Rina: I'll drop mine now. Also adding 3 talking bullets.
Priya: demo safety plan: build a replay script to switch to recorded traffic if live latency spikes. Save link to S3 and have a quick toggle in slides.
Theo: Adding sample runbook to repo: 
```
# tuning-lab runbook
# 1. boot demo infra (./scripts/boot.sh)
# 2. verify model variants: base, q4_8, q8_0
# 3. start replay: ./replay --rps 5 --profile small_chat
# 4. monitor 95p latency; if > 500ms -> switch to q4_8 with /switch-variant q4_8
# 5. if errors spike -> pause traffic and swap to recorded session
```
Rina: Love it. Also include a slide that explains tradeoffs (latency vs cost vs quality) with a simple chart.
Omar: For rehearsals: tech check 30m prior, full run-through 60m two days before, dress rehearsal 1 day before. Can we reserve 2/12 (tech check) and 2/14 (full run) now?
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: full rehearsal 2025-02-13T16:00Z -> attendees Rina,Omar,Priya,Theo.
Priya: We'll prepare a short pre-webinar survey (2 q's) to segment attendees by latency sensitivity and model usage. Use that to send tailored follow-ups.
Theo: Post-webinar nurture plan: day0 recording + repo; day3 deep-dive email per track; week2 AE outreach for 'pilot interest' leads.
Rina: Metrics to track: signup -> attendance rate, track distribution, repo forks/stars, post-webinar demo requests, AE conversion within 30d.
Omar: Can marketing ops add UTM parameters per channel and per landing variant so we can tie A/B to conversions?
ops-bot: UTM template: utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tuning_lab&utm_variant={A|B}&utm_track={chat|embed|rerank}
Priya: Who's writing slides? Rina + Theo draft, Priya adds case slides. I'll assemble final deck by 2/10.
Rina: I'll create the calendar and add recording + captions request. Also suggest a 2-line speaker intro for moderators.
Theo: Quick ask: include a brief appendix with recommended batch sizes / cache TTL defaults — helps attendees take action.
Omar: Agreed. keep the actionable checklist short.
Rina: OK locking plan. next steps: speakers submit bio/headshot by Friday, Theo to create three starter repos by 2/1, ops to confirm rehearsal slots. I'll post the landing copy drafts tomorrow for A/B review.
Priya: :thumbsup:
